segments.title: Larkin House Funding Application Overview
description: Application for Heritage Conservation Program funding for Larkin House.
House designated in 2007, built 1928, colonial style.
Proposed work includes pillar repairs and exterior painting.
Project cost $27,140, grant requested $13,570.

chips.text: $13,570 grant for Larkin House repairs
Applications over $10,000 require committee approval

segments.title: Committee Questions on Repair Process and Quality
description: Questions raised about physical process, site inspections, material quality.
Staff confirms site inspection after work and receipt submission.
Grant is paid by check over three years.
Heritage committee endorses funding before PDCS approval.

chips.text: Heritage committee endorses, PDCS approves funding
Staff will conduct site inspection after work completion

segments.title: Debate on Pillar Structural Integrity and Future Repairs
description: Concerns raised about structural integrity of deteriorated pillars.
Previous grant in 2007 was for painting, not pillars.
Discussion on water damage, wood acting as a sponge.
Committee members concerned about repeated applications for same repairs.

chips.text: Unclear if contractors will address structural integrity of pillars
Wood base acts as a sponge, may need replacement for longevity

segments.title: Supporting Homeowners with Unexpected Repair Discoveries
description: Concern about homeowner burden and lack of designation incentive.

chips.text: Administration can approve funding under $10,000 for surprises
